children: Shares of Service Properties Trust surged after TKO LLC said it proposed purchasing Service Properties Trust's hotel portfolio.
The company's stock closed up 15%, at $7.15, Friday and added another 2% after hours.
TKO LLC said the proposed purchase price for the portfolio is $2 billion. Service Properties Trust didn't immediately respond to requests for comment.
Hospitality-focused investment company TKO LLC buys and repositions hotel assets across the U.S., according to the Aberdeen, S.D., company.
Write to Josh Beckerman at josh.beckerman@wsj.com
Service Properties Trust to Review Unsolicited Offer for Hotels From TKO LLC — Update
Service Properties Trust will review an unsolicited proposal it received from TKO LLC for its hotel portfolio for $2 billion, the real estate investment trust said.
The company said it would carefully review and consider TKO LLC's proposal.
"Before receiving the proposal, the Company had no prior contact from TKO," Service Properties Trust said.
The company's stock closed up 15%, at $7.15, Friday and was at $7.17 after hours.
Hospitality-focused investment company TKO LLC buys and repositions hotel assets across the U.S., according to the Aberdeen, S.D., company.
As of June 30, Service Properties Trust owned 745 service-focused retail net lease properties and 93 hotels.
